common_basis.mass_basis: dry roasted coffee unless an operator explicitly declares another basis

decisions.quantity_or_hypothesis: T_total[a], I_ref_initial[a], I_ref_spent[a], M_fraction[a,j], M_cup[a], M_retained[a], and closure_residual[a] form a commensurate operational mass closure
decisions.symbol: T_total[a]; I_ref_initial[a]; I_ref_spent[a]; M_fraction[a,j]; M_cup[a]; M_retained[a]; closure_residual[a]
decisions.reporting_unit: mg analyte and mg analyte/kg dry roasted coffee

basis.volume: not substituted for mass without qualified density

decisions.physical_state: unbrewed coffee, beverage fractions, retained liquids, and recovered spent puck
decisions.spatial_support: linked aliquot/whole shot/all declared recovery locations
decisions.temporal_support: initial preparation, complete fraction sequence, post-shot recovery, complete sequential extraction
decisions.population_material_regime: local traceable coffee lot and declared preparation/machine regime
decisions.current_ewp_consumer: absolute species inventory and fraction-observer comparisons
decisions.blocker: no paired commensurate initial/cup/retained/spent closure with qualified uncertainty
decisions.estimand: For analyte a: T_total is total assayable mass per dry coffee mass; I_ref_initial and I_ref_spent are method-conditioned cumulative blank-corrected sequential recoveries; M_fraction[a,j]=qualified concentration times qualified fraction amount with dilution/recovery; M_cup is the sum of qualified fraction masses plus declared whole-cup/collector-rinse terms; M_retained is the sum over declared retained locations; closure_residual is the signed declared input minus all observed output/residual terms.
decisions.observation_operator: Apply versioned calibration, blank, recovery, dilution, moisture, and mass operators to each raw response; preserve covariance; sum declared terms. closure_residual[a]=I_ref_initial[a]-M_cup[a]-M_retained[a]-I_ref_spent[a]-M_other_declared[a]. M_other_declared is observed or the result is incomplete; it is never assumed zero. T_total is not substituted for I_ref.
decisions.uncertainty_requirement: Combined covariance-aware uncertainty including heterogeneity, aliquot, moisture, preparation, recovery, tail, retained/spent recovery, dilution, calibration, batch, injection, and shot components; PILOT_REQUIRED
decisions.materiality: DESIGN_CALCULATION_REQUIRED from the smallest closure uncertainty/residual that changes authorization of a later inventory bridge or chemistry comparison

outcomes.negative: qualified closure/recovery variability exceeds decision utility
outcomes.null: interval overlaps both useful and disproportionate regions
outcomes.blocked: operator, endpoint, recovery, LOQ, covariance, or lineage cannot be qualified

actions.positive: authorize consideration of a separate G1 I_ref-to-production-inventory bridge test; adopt nothing
actions.negative: retain c_s0 and production inventory independent/unidentified; no predictor
actions.null: retain current treatment and refine only the named uncertainty source if proportionate
actions.blocked: request exact capability/operator input; no execution or invented value

decisions.quantity_or_hypothesis: an analyte-specific operational endpoint for I_ref can be selected from sequential extraction and tied to EWP decision materiality
decisions.temporal_support: all sequential cycles including post-endpoint retained cycles
decisions.blocker: tail behavior, variance, capability, and decision materiality unknown
decisions.estimand: cycle-specific blank-corrected recovered mass, cumulative recovery, and residual tail distribution separately for each analyte and matrix
decisions.observation_operator: Retain signed blank-corrected responses and censoring model; estimate each cycle mass and covariance, cumulative recovery, and a declared tail bound/model without clipping. Stage F gathers enough cycles to characterize feasible tail behavior; a later endpoint is selected only by a frozen decision-materiality calculation.
decisions.uncertainty_requirement: Propagate blank, calibration, recovery, preparation, fraction/cumulative covariance, censoring, and tail-model uncertainty; PILOT_REQUIRED
decisions.materiality: Endpoint omission bound must be below the future named EWP decision threshold; threshold DESIGN_CALCULATION_REQUIRED after Stage F

outcomes.positive: finite feasible analyte-specific endpoint can be frozen later
outcomes.negative: tail remains decision-material at feasible limit
outcomes.blocked: maximum feasible cycle or analytical capability not supplied

actions.positive: design a separately authorized Stage D freeze
actions.negative: do not qualify I_ref for the intended decision
actions.null: no decision; revise feasibility only if marginally valuable
